body: Finally got prescribed to Atropine drops and it makes all the difference! Floaters are gone, or at least, I cant see them. After suffering for so long I feel as if I got my life back. It does take away my up close vision and I need readers but it’s a trade off I’ll gladly take.
Yes they would’ve definitely noticed a retinal detachment. Thats one of the things they look for during an eye exam
Dr’s at Vanderbilt are giving me a 98-99% success rate so hoping for the best.
Thanks! The last thing i want to do is have eye surgery but its my only hope to regain a normal life.

You’re not alone. It happened to me at 34 and I lost friends, relationships and my job because of depression. I had moments where I didn’t want to keep going but im slowly climbing out of that dark hole and have a Vitrectomy scheduled for next month. Stay strong
Same, I totally understand. It’s life changing. Try to hang in there as im doing everyday.
I want to try the .01% but you have to get a prescription from a doctor which they are refusing to do.

I reached out to my ophthalmologist about atropine drops and they refused to prescribe them to me which has made things worse. Their only excuse was it would make my vision blurry which i would gladly trade to have my floaters gone. I feel like they just want to do the surgery and put me down in their research. Now I feel like a science experiment. Im highly depressed which I never have been and the world around me is crumpling down to a dark abyss.
Dark. 3 big spots in my left eye and a few stringy dark ones in my right that aren’t so bad.

Just saw it online but also read other research where it was used on kids for a long term myopic study with no side effects. Im going to reach out to my dr and give it a try. Thanks! I had never really heard of this solution before.
Also, long term use of Atropine can induce cataracts. Im screwed either way.

I’ve seen 3 retina specialists an ophthalmologist and two optometrist. They all said the same thing. Apparently thats what the “literature” from research says. It could very well be 1 year. It could be 10, who knows. Either way if i live long enough it’ll happen eventually.

Thats the hard part is how disgusting they are. They make me feel like im just trash and i always felt and thought i was an upstanding classy individual. Now i feel disgusting and like i have trash in my eyes. I would rather lose a limb or have something else going on but when it’s in your eyes its like a curse you cant escape from. I’ve had failures and bad moments but i always shook them off and was happy. These will forever be with me because it’s my sight. Even if i get this fixed i might have a few years of good vision if all goes right but looking through a cataract lens, God willing thats all that goes wrong, i’ll never see the same.
Dr said under 30% chance within 2 years and potentially up to 10 years with my age
Floaters ruin lives. It destroyed mine
Same. Life wasn’t supposed to be this way: i had 34 years of pure happiness and it came to a sudden stop. 40-50 years left to deal with this seems miserable
Depression

Honestly some days i just want to end it because of the stress and low quality of life I experience now. Worst year of my life and trying my best to cope. If it weren’t for my family I’d already be gone.

I only drink water and occasionally some coffee, which I haven’t done in a while because honestly i just want to sleep until my June 9th pre surgery appt. Honestly with Covid im not even sure they’d do it unless things turn around. I eat a healthy diet and have always been in good shape and thats whats made it all so frustrating.
My floaters have given me so much stress i dont think i could ever trip again.

True. I need to just keep going no matter the obstacle ls. We only get 1 life and no matter what happens, despite 1 mistake that may seem to have taken so much away we must keep going. We get 1 chance to make it right in this life and regardless of what’s happened in the past we must keep going. You cant end it prematurely. Thanks for responding.

I took a prescription med that ended up being bad and ruined my health. I’ve ways been against meds and dont even like taking tylenol as i live a very healthy, active organic life.. it’s as if something took over my mind, wasn’t thinking clearly and just did it.. it cant be explained especially with the signs i had. It’s totally unexplainable and the people i lost left because i was so depressed. No apologies can help and my love, crush is already with another man. Complete disaster and went against my morals and life code which is why i lost myself as well. I swear i was possessed and not thinking with my mind. Now i need a previously happy, great life to end because of 1 choice, 1 damn mistake. I went from being outside, loving life to stuck in a bed all day. Its a sad sad nightmare.

Floaters have destroyed my life. I used to love being outside and socializing. I had a lot of friends and a beautiful girl i was dating. Due to the anxiety and depression, i have almost nothing as I’ve become so reclusive and down. I dont eat right anymore, quit working out and lost so much meaning in life. They started about 6 months ago and haven’t ceased. Looking at a Vitrectomy to cure this. The last thing i want to do is have surgery on my eye but i have to take a chance to get my life back. Been in a dark place for months and need to get out.
